basis: MOOSE consumes the Modeled Actor Protocol public actor and addressed World speech profiles in its public views and native rooms.

cases.claim: A transported native rule retains its original witness and byte-valued conclusion through World restoration and reclosure.
cases.test: a World restores the original witness for a byte-valued rule received through canonical CBOR

cases.claim: A room retains each admitted activity occurrence through checkpoint and restart and exposes it only through its observer's reading.
cases.test: addressed World speech retains distinct witnessed occurrences across checkpoint and restart

cases.claim: Inbound and outbound room speech require the current room Group and exact unopposed directional grants.
cases.test: World speech requires the current room Group and unopposed authority in both directions

cases.claim: A retired actor contributes no posts and an invalid continuation from an active actor fails the public reading.
cases.test: a retired actor is skipped and a foreign page refuses the timeline

cases.claim: Both public views display a current post on a later page while respecting a newer deletion.
cases.test: the actor homepage displays a public post from the next outbox page

cases.claim: An actor can publish and edit a Note, recover it through the protocol and human page after restart, and delete it. Anonymous writes are refused.
cases.test: a commissioned MOOSE node reads an edited note on page two after restart and retracts it on delete
